title: Bank of Ceylon (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE BANK OF CEYLON ORDINANCE.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Amendment of First Schedule to Chapter 397
body.raw_text: 2. Part II of the First Schedule to the Bank of Ceylon Ordinance is hereby amended, in item 3, by the omission of paragraphs (c) and (d) of that item.
body.text: Part II of the First Schedule to the Bank of Ceylon Ordinance is hereby amended, in item 3, by the omission of paragraphs (c) and (d) of that item.
